== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk (V)]]: the PC card image of [[Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk (V)]] (19 August 2026, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9aaa4af0babb58c41dad0a6767d432b3a51e1f4c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Light/large/chewbaccaofkashyyyk.gif holotable 9aaa4af], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (page 3). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
